title: MusicDrop v1.6.0 Available
changelog:
• Voice Search Integration: Tap the new microphone button in the search bar to speak and instantly search songs, artists, or albums via Google Speech Recognizer
• Hip-Hop & Regional Rapper Avatars: Updated Desi Hip Hop, Gully Icons, Mallu Rappers, and Tamil Rappers with verified high-resolution artist avatars and glowing gradient initials fallback cards
• JioSaavn Live Refresh & 2026 Releases: Added live cache-busting and fresh 2026 trending release queries, plus a dedicated one-tap Refresh button on the JioSaavn screen
• Trending & Speed Dial Album Songs: Fixed album track resolution across YouTube Music MPRE albums, OLAK playlists, and custom album cards so tapping any album in Speed Dial or New Releases always shows its full tracklist
